name: Oberlin College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college and conservatory of music founded in 1833 (oldest coeducational liberal arts college in the U.S.). Ranked tied for 55th among national liberal arts colleges by U.S. News & World Report (2025). Enrollment ~3,000 across the College of Arts & Sciences and the Conservatory, with 50+ majors/minors. Associated with more MacArthur fellows than any other liberal arts college and among the top producers of Fulbright scholars.
financial_aid: As a private institution, Oberlin does not offer athletic scholarships (NCAA Division III). Financial aid is need-based and merit-based; the college offers the Oberlin Commitment (a $10,000 scholarship reference) and a MyinTuition quick cost estimator. Total 2025-26 comprehensive cost of attendance is approximately $89,578 (tuition $68,340 + housing $9,970 + meal plan $10,126 + fees $1,142). Source: oberlin.edu/admissions-and-aid/tuition-and-fees, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball is played at Dill Field on the Oberlin College campus (listed among Oberlin athletics facilities on goyeo.com). No additional facility specifications were publicly listed.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the North Coast Athletic Conference (NCAC). No athletic scholarships offered per Division III rules. Team social media account is @Yeo_Softball.
notes: Data gathered from goyeo.com softball coaches and roster pages and oberlin.edu tuition/aid pages, fetched 2026-07. Roster size (20) from the 2026 softball roster page. As a D3 program, no athletic scholarships are awarded, so scholarship_count is null.
